sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Battles inside generated villages (vanilla and modded variants).

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Poison moves, bug moves, and steel moves are 1.3× stronger.
First Impression also counts as Normal for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Beat Up, First Impression, Pay Day, Smog, Steamroller, and Techno Blast: 1.5× stronger.
Poison Gas and Smog: never miss.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Normal-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Covet, Pursuit, and Thief change the field into Back Alley.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Big Pecks: Defense +1 when it enters.
Early Bird: Attack +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
